text:
Maya Chen: FYI Novus renewal meeting Friday. They asked for a short SLA evidence pack + 1-page TCQ for their SREs. Can we deliver by Thu EOD? Ticket CS-5010

Devon Kaur: I can pull rolling 30/90d uptime and per-route p95/p99. Need tenant id and whether to include node_id breakdown.

Maya Chen: Tenant 77011. Include node_id and model_variant. They care about embed vs generate splits since they run heavy embedding workloads.

Priya Desai: Onboarding tidbit: they enabled prefix caching and set a custom TTL. I'll export the config diff and add a validation snippet for cache hits.

Sam Ortiz: Note: Novus is medium renewal risk. Pack should have a plain-English credit example + a one-line exec summary for procurement. Keep legal wording minimal.

Alex Liu: Draft credit example ready to paste:
SLO 99.9% monthly uptime. Observed 99.55% => downtime = (1 - 0.9955) * 720h = 3.24h. Credit = pro-rated portion of monthly fee up to cap after exclusions.

sla-bot: System alert  rolling 90d uptime for tenant 77011 = 99.91%. Rolling p99 generate = 210ms. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/account/77011

Devon Kaur: Export uploaded: https://storage.redwood.ai/exports/CS-5010/77011_metrics_90d.csv (expires in 7d). Columns: ts,route,latency_ms,p99,p95,tokens_in,tokens_out,node_id,model_variant,status

Maya Chen: For the TCQ include: dashboard view links, kubectl/logstash snippets, steps to reproduce a cache miss/hit, and model/quant profile used.

Priya Desai: kubectl snippet to show tenant 77011 recent latency:
kubectl logs -l app=runtime -c inference --since=48h | grep "tenant=77011" | jq '.route, .latency_ms'
I'll add cache validation curl example too.

Devon Kaur: Observed note: tail p99 on generate aligns with requests >3.5k tokens. Embeds remain ~<200ms p99. Will call that out in the evidence blurb.

Sam Ortiz: I'll write the 1-line executive summary and add a tiny FAQ: "How credits apply" + "How uptime measured". Keep it 2 sentences each.

Alex Liu: FAQ bullets drafted and added sample table for quick procurement paste.

Maya Chen: Action items: 1) Devon: metrics export link (done) 2) Priya: onboarding config + cache runbook (in progress) 3) Alex: credit calc + FAQ (due Wed EOD) 4) Maya: assemble final PDF and upload to ticket CS-5010 (Thu morning).

Devon Kaur: One more: include quant profile for embed model (they use q4_0_latency). That shifts embed numbers by ~10ms baseline.

Priya Desai: Adding that to runbook. Cache validation curl:
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/embed -d '{"tenant":"77011","input":"cache-test"}' | grep X-Cache

Maya Chen: I'll compile into a 2-page pack: page 1 evidence (metrics + link + model/quant details) page 2 TCQ (commands, cache validation, maintenance exclusions) + exec one-liner.

sla-bot: Ticket CS-5010 updated  evidence_pack_v1.pdf uploaded by maya.chen at 1766005555. Link: https://tickets.redwood.ai/cs/CS-5010/evidence_pack_v1.pdf

Maya Chen: Uploaded. Please review and flag anything critical; will send to Novus after legal sign-off.
